敵の前線基地の司令: Commander of the enemy forward base
やった……！ みんなで帰ろう！: We did it…! Let's all go home!
敵の前線基地はこの小惑星帯の先。岩をよけて進んで: The enemy forward base is past this asteroid belt. Weave through the rocks.
編隊を全滅！ 強化を取って: Formation wiped out! Grab the power-up.
レーダー塔を全部潰した。防衛コアの砲台が2基止まるはず: All radar towers down. That should knock out 2 of the Defense Core's turrets.
沈没艦の墓場に入る。漂う残骸に気をつけて: Entering the Graveyard of Sunken Ships. Watch the drifting wreckage.
基地の外周に入る。砲台と燃料タンクを撃って。レーダー塔を全部壊せばボス戦が楽にな: Entering the base perimeter. Shoot the turrets and fuel tanks. Take out every radar tower and the boss fight gets easier.
基地の内部へ突入！ 狭いぞ: Breaching the base interior! It's tight in there.
通路を抜けた！ 防衛線だ: Through the corridor! That's the defense line.
基地の奥から巨大な熱源！ 防衛コアが来る: Massive heat source deep in the base! The Defense Core is coming.
レーダーが落ちて、砲台が2基止まっている。残りを叩いて: Radar's down, so 2 turrets are offline. Hit the rest.
砲台を全部壊せば腕が外れる。予告の線を見て、向きを変えて: Destroy all the turrets and the arms come off. Watch the warning lines and change your heading.
砲台が全滅。腕が外れた！ 光線の輪は間をくぐるか、外へ抜けて: All turrets down. The arms are off! Slip through the gaps in the beam rings, or get outside them.
腕が全部落ちた。炉が開く！ 撃ち込んで。突進は回避の回転でかわして: All arms down. The reactor's opening! Pour it on. Dodge-roll to evade its charge.
柱が倒れてくる！ 上か下へ: Pillar coming down! Go high or low.
隔壁が閉まる！ 上の隙間へ: Bulkhead closing! Through the top gap.
隔壁が閉まる！ 下の隙間へ: Bulkhead closing! Through the bottom gap.
前方に巨大な機影！ 機械の大蛇だ。体当たりに気をつけろ: Huge contact ahead! It's the Mechanical Serpent. Watch out for ramming.
背中の砲台は壊せる。口の光線は、主砲を溜めて口へ撃ち返せば押し返せる: The turrets on its back can be destroyed. Charge your main cannon and fire into its mouth to push back the mouth beam.
主砲を溜めて、撃つ瞬間に口へ撃ち返せ！ 光線を押し返せる: Charge your main cannon and fire back into its mouth the moment it shoots! You can push the beam back.
遠すぎて押し切れない！ 近づいて撃ち返せ！: Too far to overpower it! Get closer and fire back!
押し切った！ 大蛇の口に叩き込んだぞ！: Overpowered! Rammed it right down the Serpent's throat!
噛みつかれた！ 突進は回避の回転でかわせ: It bit you! Dodge-roll to evade its charge.
砲台を潰した！ 背中の砲台は壊せる、潰せば弾幕が減る: Turret down! The back turrets can be destroyed—take them out to thin the barrage.
背中の砲台を全部潰した！ もう弾幕は来ない: All back turrets down! No more barrage.
大蛇の装甲が割れた！ 薙ぎ払いが来る、光線の線を見て横へ: The Serpent's armor cracked! Sweep incoming—watch the beam line and move sideways.
あと少し！ 頭を狙え。光線は主砲で押し返せ: Almost there! Aim for the head. Push the beam back with your main cannon.
大蛇の動きが止まった！ 離れて！: The Serpent's stopped moving! Pull away!
背中の砲台は壊せる。口の光線は、溜めている口をレールガンで撃ち抜けば止められる: The turrets on its back can be destroyed. To stop the mouth beam, pierce its charging mouth with your railgun.
口が光ってる！ 撃たれる前にレールガンで撃ち抜け！: Its mouth is glowing! Pierce it with your railgun before it fires!
あと少し！ 頭を狙え。光線はレールガンで撃ち抜いて止めろ: Almost there! Aim for the head. Stop the beam by piercing it with your railgun.
二人とも付いてる。大蛇の頭を集中して叩くぞ！: We're both with you. Focus fire on the Serpent's head!
こっちも付いていく。金属の輪を3つくぐれば、ツインを強化できるぞ: We're coming with you. Fly through 3 metal rings and you can power up your Twin.
二人とも付いてる。炉を集中して叩くぞ！: We're both with you. Focus fire on the reactor!
後ろに付かれた！ 振り切れない、撃ち落として！: Bandit on my tail! Can't shake it—shoot it down!
助かった！ 借りができたな: Thanks, that was close! I owe you one.
後ろ！ 急減速か宙返りで前へ出して: Behind you! Hard brake or loop—make it overshoot.
右の箱に爆雷が入ってる。撃って開けて: Bomb in the crate on the right. Shoot it open.
侵入機を確認。外周の砲台は全基で迎え撃て。: Intruder confirmed. All perimeter turrets, engage.
内部へ入られただと？ 隔壁を閉じろ。: They got inside? Seal the bulkheads.
……前線基地を放棄する。全員、退け。: …We abandon the forward base. All units, withdraw.
その橙の機体、あたしが遊んであげる。: Hey, orange one—you're mine to play with.
ちっ、今日はここまで。次は落とすよ。: Tch. That's it for today. Next time, you're going down.

狙いの補正があり遠くまで届く。どこでも使えるが、近距離や硬い敵では他に劣る: Aim-assisted and long-reaching. Works anywhere, but falls behind others up close or against tough enemies.
近づいて硬い敵を削るのに強い。補正がなく弾がぶれ、射程の外や遠くの小さな敵には弱: Great for grinding down tough enemies up close. No aim assist and a wide spread; weak out of range or against small, distant targets.
至近の編隊と硬い敵に最も強い。遠いほど弱まり、150より遠くでは3割まで落ちる: Strongest against point-blank formations and tough enemies. Weakens with distance, dropping to 30% beyond 150.
弾数無限で1回の総量が大きく、並んだ敵を貫く。溜める間は撃てず、急な敵には間に合: Unlimited ammo and huge damage per shot; pierces lined-up enemies. Can't fire while charging, so it's too slow for sudden threats.
溜めなしで遠くの硬い敵を撃ち抜き、並んだ敵も貫く。大蛇が溜めている口を撃ち抜くと: No charge needed: pierces tough distant enemies and lined-up foes. Piercing the Serpent's charging mouth stops its beam. Low ammo, but it slowly refills.
弾数無限で狙いもいらず、中距離で安定して当たる。遠くには届かず、1回は軽い: Unlimited ammo, no aiming needed, hits reliably at mid range. Can't reach far, and each volley is light.
狙い不要で遠くの8機まで一斉に撃てる。1発が軽く弾数も限られ、硬い敵は落とせない: No aiming needed: fires at up to 8 distant targets at once. Light hits and limited ammo; can't down tough enemies.
1発の威力と範囲が最大で、群れにも硬い敵にも効く。誘導せず弾が遅いので、外すと損: Biggest single-shot damage and blast radius; works on swarms and tough enemies. No homing and slow, so misses hurt.
周りの敵の弾を消し、雑魚をまとめて落とす。数が少なく、硬い敵にはほとんど効かない: Clears nearby enemy shots and wipes out small fry. Few in stock; barely affects tough enemies.
